commands.name: check
commands.does: Runs all 13 checks and prints 'LEVEL [check] message' lines plus a summary such as 'check_skill: 13 checks · N error(s) · M warning(s) → OK/FAIL'. Exits 1 on any error.

commands.name: --strict
commands.does: Same checks, but warnings also fail the run (exit 1).

commands.name: --json
commands.does: Prints one JSON object {ok, errors, warnings, checks, items[{level, check, message}]} instead of text lines.

commands.name: --evals
commands.does: Runs all checks, then the routing evals: for each case in evals/evals.json with a routing block it calls powers.suggest in-process on the query and passes when one of expect_any's family prefixes is in the top K (plus expect_all, expect_domain and motion_output when set). Prints PASS/FAIL/SKIP per case and the pass rate; exits 1 if the checks fail or routing falls below --min-pass.

commands.name: --min-pass
commands.does: Sets the routing pass rate that --evals requires (default 0.8).

commands.name: --print-counts
commands.does: Prints the '<!-- counts: powers=… families=… … -->' marker computed from the live catalog and exits 0 without running any checks.

commands.name: --verbose
commands.does: Also prints info lines: record, proof-path, link, chapter, eval and registry counts.

tools.inputs: No file arguments. It reads SKILL.md, data/powers/*.json, data/tools.json (through scripts/hub.py), references/, proofs/, evals/evals.json and the scripts/ listing in the skill, plus the repo's tools/ listing and entry docs (README.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, CAPABILITIES.md, llms.txt). Proof paths are only tested for existence, relative to the folder that holds the repo (e.g. /home/user).
tools.outputs: Text report on stdout, or one JSON object with --json. With --evals it adds a PASS/FAIL/SKIP table and the pass rate. Exit 0 = OK; exit 1 = errors, warnings under --strict, or routing below the threshold.
tools.limits: It checks structure, links, counts and registry consistency only: the routing evals test search ranking, not whether any power works, and proofs outside this checkout are skipped rather than verified.
tools.evidence_note: Not run: no test file in tests/ or evals/ exercises it (CI runs it from .github/workflows/ci.yml and skill-package.yml). Manual runs on HEAD 524e22a (clean tree): --help exit 0; the full run exits 1 with 52 errors and 1 warning (42 scripts/tools not yet in data/tools.json, 2 stale/missing chapters, 3 counts-marker and 4 drift mismatches against 4,784 powers, 1 broken link to powers/runnable-tools.md); --evals routing passed 82/82 (100%); --print-counts exit 0 (powers=4784 families=53 domains=10); --json --evals output fails json.loads ('Extra data').

tools.summary_en: Validates the skill with check_skill.py, then zips it deterministically into kosif-superpowers.skill for upload to claude.ai. The archive has a single top folder and one SKILL.md, whose description is replaced by the ≤200-character claude_ai_description. dist/, caches, vendor/, evals/ and (with --lite) media are left out, and the finished archive is re-verified.
tools.summary_ar: يتحقق من المهارة بالأداة check_skill.py، ثم يضغطها ضغطًا حتميًا في ملف kosif-superpowers.skill لرفعه إلى claude.ai. يضم الأرشيف مجلدًا علويًا واحدًا وملف SKILL.md واحدًا يُستبدل وصفه بالوصف القصير claude_ai_description (200 حرف على الأكثر). يستبعد dist/ ومجلدات الذاكرة المؤقتة وvendor/ وevals/، ويستبعد الوسائط أيضًا مع الخيار --lite، ثم يتحقق من الأرشيف الناتج.
use_when: حزّم المهارة عشان أرفعها على claude.ai
اعمل ملف .skill خفيف من غير صور وفيديو
أبي ملف zip للمهارة أرفعه في Claude
package the skill for upload to claude.ai
list which files would go into the skill zip

commands.name: package
commands.does: Runs check_skill.py in-process (stops on errors), then writes dist/kosif-superpowers.skill inside the skill (dist/ is git-ignored). Prints the file count, unpacked and zipped sizes, and an upload hint.

commands.name: --lite
commands.does: Leaves out images, audio and video (all text and fonts stay) and writes kosif-superpowers-lite.skill.

commands.name: --out
commands.does: Writes to another folder or exact .skill/.zip file name. A destination inside the skill folder other than dist/ is refused (exit 1).

commands.name: --with-evals
commands.does: Keeps evals/ in the package (normally excluded as dev-only).

commands.name: --no-check
commands.does: Skips the check_skill.py validation step and packages anyway.

commands.name: --list
commands.does: Prints every file that would be packed plus the skip counts by reason, and writes nothing.

tools.inputs: The skill folder on disk: every file not excluded, including untracked ones. Options: -o/--out (a folder, or a .skill/.zip path outside the skill or under its dist/), --lite, --with-evals, --no-check, --list.
tools.outputs: A zip named kosif-superpowers.skill or kosif-superpowers-lite.skill (default: dist/ inside the skill), with the top folder kosif-superpowers/ and fixed timestamps; plus a size summary on stdout. Exit 1 on validation failure, a destination inside the skill folder, a description longer than 200 characters, or archive problems (corrupt entry, wrong top folder, nested SKILL.md).
tools.consent: Writes a .skill zip (default dist/ inside the skill; -o can write anywhere outside it). It packs every non-excluded file on disk, untracked ones included, so review --list before sharing the archive.
tools.limits: It only builds the upload zip and never uploads anything; no claude.ai size cap is documented, so whether claude.ai accepts a large package is untested.
tools.evidence_note: tests.test_superpowers_unified passed 7/7; only test_portable_package_excludes_nested_skills touches this tool (it imports package_skill and checks collect(): SKILL.md included, vendor/ excluded). Manual runs on HEAD 524e22a: --help exit 0; --list 521 files, --list --lite 496, --list --lite --with-evals 541; --lite --no-check -o <scratch>/ wrote a 6.8 MB zip of 496 files with one top folder, one SKILL.md, claude_ai_description removed, no evals or media; '--lite --no-check -o ./out/' from the skill root was refused (exit 1) before writing. The default run is refused because check_skill fails at HEAD.

tools.summary_en: Recomputes the proof_scope field of every power record from where its proof entries resolve on this machine (repo > session > archive > sibling > receipt > style > url > missing/none) and rewrites data/powers/*.json in place. With --check it only reports how many records would change.
tools.summary_ar: يعيد حساب الحقل proof_scope لكل سجل قدرة بحسب المكان الذي تشير إليه أدلته على هذا الجهاز (repo ثم session ثم archive ثم sibling ثم receipt ثم style ثم url ثم missing/none)، ويعيد كتابة ملفات data/powers/*.json في مكانها. أما مع الخيار --check فيكتفي بالإبلاغ عن عدد السجلات التي ستتغير.
use_when: حدّث proof_scope لكل القدرات
check_skill بيقول ✅ محتاج proof_scope، صلّحها
كم قدرة مثبتة بدليل موجود داخل المستودع؟
recompute proof_scope on every power record
check whether any proof scope labels are out of date

commands.name: relabel
commands.does: Rewrites every data/powers/*.json that has a record whose proof_scope differs, inserting proof_scope right after proof and re-serialising the file with its detected indent. Prints the proven count by scope and 'relabelled N record(s)'; exit 0.

commands.name: --check
commands.does: Writes nothing. Prints the proven count by scope and 'would change N record(s)', and exits 1 when N > 0.

tools.inputs: data/powers/*.json and the repository files that 'kosif-tool/...' proof paths point to (existence only). The only recognised argument is --check.
tools.outputs: Updated data/powers/*.json (relabel mode) and two stdout lines: proven counts by scope, and the number of records relabelled or that would change.
tools.consent: A run without --check rewrites data/powers/*.json in place: run --check first, and relabel only on a full kosif-tool checkout, because a partial copy relabels repo proofs as missing. --help and a mistyped flag only print usage.
tools.limits: It labels where a proof points, not whether the proof is valid: 'sibling' is assigned from the path shape alone without checking the other repository, and 'repo' only means the file exists.
tools.evidence_note: Not run: no test file exercises the CLI (CI runs --check; evals/test_hub.py only reaches record_scope() indirectly through hub.py build --check). Manual runs on HEAD 524e22a: --check exit 0, 'would change 0 record(s)', proven by scope: repo 532, sibling 368, receipt 1. In a git-archive copy holding only the skill and tests/, --check reported 559 records would change (exit 1), which shows the result depends on which repo files exist. --help was not run because it would execute the rewrite.

tools.summary_en: Regenerates every derived file of the motion style atlas from catalog/styles.json, categories.json and briefs.json: each style's styles/<id>/SKILL.md and STYLE.json, STYLE_INDEX.md, catalog/playbooks.json, meta.json, prompts_motion.json, the normalised catalog/styles.json, sitemap.xml and the stats block in README.md. --check only reports drift.
tools.summary_ar: يعيد توليد كل الملفات المشتقة في أطلس أساليب الموشن انطلاقًا من catalog/styles.json وcategories.json وbriefs.json: ملفي styles/<id>/SKILL.md وSTYLE.json لكل أسلوب، وملف STYLE_INDEX.md، وcatalog/playbooks.json وmeta.json وprompts_motion.json، والنسخة المنسَّقة من catalog/styles.json، وsitemap.xml، وكتلة الإحصاءات في README.md. أما الخيار --check فيكتفي بالإبلاغ عن الملفات غير المحدَّثة.
use_when: بعد ما عدّلت catalog/styles.json ولّد ملفات الأساليب من جديد
حدّث STYLE_INDEX.md وخريطة الموقع
تأكد إن الملفات المشتقة للأطلس محدّثة
regenerate the style SKILL.md files and STYLE_INDEX after a catalog change
check that the derived atlas files are up to date before CI

commands.name: build
commands.does: Rewrites only the derived files whose content changed and prints 'regenerated N files (S styles, P playbooks, B briefs)'.

commands.name: --check
commands.does: Writes nothing. Prints 'derived files up to date' (exit 0), or lists up to 20 out-of-date paths (exit 1).

tools.inputs: catalog/styles.json, catalog/categories.json, catalog/briefs.json (optional), playbooks/*.md, styles/<id>/kit/README.md when present, and the <!-- stats:start/end --> markers in README.md. No file arguments.
tools.outputs: styles/<id>/SKILL.md and STYLE.json for every style, STYLE_INDEX.md, catalog/playbooks.json, catalog/meta.json, catalog/prompts_motion.json, a re-serialised catalog/styles.json (with skill/playbooks fields added and dead brief paths cleared), sitemap.xml and the README.md stats block.
tools.consent: A plain run overwrites tracked files across the repo (catalog/styles.json, every styles/<id>/SKILL.md and STYLE.json, STYLE_INDEX.md, sitemap.xml and the README.md stats block); run --check first.
tools.limits: It generates text guides and indexes from catalog metadata only: it never fetches or inspects the referenced videos and does not validate the catalog (tools/validate.py does that).
tools.evidence_note: Not run: no test file runs tools/build.py (tests/test_validate.py and tests/test_cli.py exercise validate.py and kosif.py on fixture repos; CI runs build.py --check). Manual runs here on HEAD 524e22a: --help exit 0; --check exit 0, 'derived files up to date'.

tools.summary_en: Compares the English text of each pm- brief in batch JSON files with the creator's saved public description (<slug>.txt), reports every shared run of N consecutive words (default 6) and exits 1 when any brief is flagged.
tools.summary_ar: يقارن النص الإنجليزي لكل ملف إبداعي يبدأ معرّفه بـ pm- في ملفات JSON بالوصف العام المحفوظ لصاحب المرجع (<slug>.txt)، ويبلّغ عن كل سلسلة مشتركة من N كلمات متتالية (6 افتراضيًا)، وينتهي برمز الخروج 1 إذا رُصد أي تطابق.
use_when: تأكد إن البريفات مش منقولة من وصف المصدر
افحص أصالة الملفات الإبداعية قبل الاستيراد
Check briefs for wording copied from the source descriptions
Flag 6-word overlaps between our briefs and the creator text

commands.name: check
commands.does: For each brief whose id starts with pm- and that has a matching <slug>.txt in --texts, it lists the distinct shared 6-word sequences and prints the first 5. The windows overlap, so one long copied passage gives many hits. It ends with a 'checked N briefs, flagged M' line and exits 1 if anything is flagged. Both flags are required (exit 2 without them).

commands.name: --ngram
commands.does: Sets the shared-run length that counts as reuse.

tools.inputs: --briefs: a folder of batch *.json files ({"briefs": [...]}). --texts: a folder of <slug>.txt source descriptions kept outside the repo (lines starting with TITLE:, TAGS: or TYPE: are ignored).
tools.outputs: A text report on stdout. Exit 0 when clean, 1 when any brief shares a run of N or more words (an invalid JSON file also exits 1, with a traceback).
tools.limits: It finds exact lower-case n-gram overlaps in the English fields only, joined into one string. It does not check paraphrase, the Arabic fields, briefs without a matching <slug>.txt or briefs whose id does not start with pm-, and a missing or misspelled folder passes silently.
tools.evidence_note: No test file exercises it. Re-run here on synthetic scratch data: --help exit 0, and no arguments gave exit 2. A brief that copies 16 source words was flagged with 11 shared 6-word runs (exit 1), and with 9 runs at --ngram 8 (exit 1). At --ngram 20 nothing was flagged (exit 0). A non-pm id and a pm- id without a source text were skipped ('checked 1'). A nonexistent --briefs or --texts folder gave 'checked 0 briefs, flagged 0' with exit 0. An invalid JSON file raised JSONDecodeError (exit 1).

tools.summary_en: Validates batch JSON files of creative briefs ({"briefs": [...]}), writes styles/<id>/BRIEF.md for each accepted brief, and merges the brief summary fields into catalog/styles.json, catalog/prompts_motion.json, catalog/briefs.json and each STYLE.json.
tools.summary_ar: يتحقق من ملفات JSON التي تضم دفعات من الملفات الإبداعية بصيغة {"briefs": [...]}، ويكتب styles/<id>/BRIEF.md لكل ملف مقبول، ويدمج حقول الملخص في catalog/styles.json وcatalog/prompts_motion.json وcatalog/briefs.json وفي ملف STYLE.json لكل أسلوب.
use_when: استورد ملفات البريف الجديدة للكتالوج
عندي دفعة briefs بصيغة JSON، ضيفها للأطلس
أبي أتحقق من صيغة البريفات قبل ما أدخلها
Import a batch of creative briefs into the atlas
Validate brief JSON files and write BRIEF.md for each style

commands.name: import
commands.does: Reads every *.json file in the folder and exits 2 if there are none. It skips unknown ids, briefs with missing keys or wrong types, and invalid JSON files. Briefs with only value issues (difficulty outside 1-5, unknown stack, keyword or scene count out of range, unreadable aspect) are still imported. Issues go to stderr and 'imported N briefs; M total' to stdout. It rewrites all catalog files, even when nothing was imported, and exits 0.

commands.name: --strict
commands.does: Skips every brief that has any issue, still writes the valid ones, and exits 1 if any brief was invalid or had an unknown id. On an invalid JSON file it stops at once with exit 1. Briefs from earlier files already have BRIEF.md and STYLE.json written by then, but the catalog files have not been updated.

tools.inputs: A folder of *.json files, each {"briefs": [...]}. Required brief keys: id, title_ar, summary_ar, summary_en, concept_ar, concept_en, aspect, assumptions_en, scenes_en, scenes_ar, motion_rules_en, motion_rules_ar, stack, keywords, facts_from_source, duration_s and difficulty. revised_from_video (YYYY-MM-DD) is optional. Each id must already exist in catalog/styles.json.
tools.outputs: Writes styles/<id>/BRIEF.md (bilingual, with a provenance note) and styles/<id>/STYLE.json, and rewrites catalog/styles.json, catalog/prompts_motion.json and catalog/briefs.json. Prints 'imported N briefs; M total in catalog/briefs.json' to stdout and any issues to stderr.
tools.consent: Rewrites tracked catalog files in the repository (catalog/briefs.json, catalog/styles.json, catalog/prompts_motion.json, styles/<id>/BRIEF.md and STYLE.json). Briefs must be original writing, so run tools/check_originality.py on the batch first.
tools.limits: It checks only shape and simple ranges, not originality or accuracy; without --strict it imports briefs that fail the range checks, it accepts only ids already in the catalog, and it does not rebuild SKILL.md or STYLE_INDEX.md (run build.py).
tools.evidence_note: No test file exercises it. Re-run here in a scratch copy (import_briefs.py, aspects.py and the catalog JSON): --help exit 0, and an empty folder gave exit 2. With a batch of 4 briefs (valid, difficulty=9, missing concept_en, unknown id), the run without --strict imported 2 (including difficulty=9) and exited 0. With --strict it imported 1 and exited 1. With --strict plus an invalid zz.json it exited 1 after writing styles/kinetic-arabic/BRIEF.md and STYLE.json, but left catalog/styles.json and briefs.json unchanged. A top-level JSON list crashed with AttributeError.

tools.summary_en: Scrapes the public PromptsMotion library index and its detail pages (cached under .cache/promptsmotion/), extracts factual metadata only, rewrites catalog/styles.json, catalog/prompts_motion.json and every styles/<id>/STYLE.json, and flags entries that have left the index with listed=false.
tools.summary_ar: يقرأ فهرس مكتبة PromptsMotion العامة وصفحات تفاصيلها ويخزّنها مؤقتًا في ‎.cache/promptsmotion/‎، ثم يستخرج البيانات الوصفية الواقعية فقط، ويعيد كتابة catalog/styles.json وcatalog/prompts_motion.json وملف STYLE.json لكل أسلوب، ويضع listed=false على الإدخالات التي خرجت من الفهرس.

commands.name: sync
commands.does: Fetches the live index from www.promptsmotion.com (falling back to the cached index if the fetch fails) and every uncached detail page (3 retries each), then rewrites the catalog files and every STYLE.json. Exits 3 if fewer than 50 cards parse, and 2 if the index cannot be fetched and no cache exists.

commands.name: --offline
commands.does: Rebuilds the catalog from .cache/promptsmotion/home.html and pages/*.html without touching the network. Index entries with no cached detail page keep their old detail fields (date, model, effort, tech), but title, creator, poster, aspect and rank still come from the cached index. Exits 2 when no cached index exists, after it has already created .cache/promptsmotion/pages/.

commands.name: --refetch
commands.does: Ignores cached detail pages and downloads all of them again. It has no effect together with --offline.

commands.name: --limit/--workers
commands.does: Caps how many new detail pages are fetched this run (0 means all) and sets the number of parallel fetch threads (default 3).

tools.inputs: The public index at https://www.promptsmotion.com and its detail pages, or the cached copies under .cache/promptsmotion/ with --offline; also the existing catalog/styles.json (old fields are carried over) and catalog/categories.json (tag-to-category mapping).
tools.outputs: Rewrites catalog/styles.json, catalog/prompts_motion.json and styles/<id>/STYLE.json for every record (it creates styles/<id>/ folders for new entries), and caches raw HTML under .cache/promptsmotion/ (gitignored). A summary (records, new, changed, unlisted) goes to stderr. Run python3 tools/build.py and python3 tools/validate.py afterwards.
tools.consent: Contacts www.promptsmotion.com to scrape its public index and detail pages, then rewrites tracked catalog files in the repository (catalog/styles.json, catalog/prompts_motion.json, every styles/<id>/STYLE.json). As written it also drops the 'dua' style from the catalog, so review git diff before committing.
tools.limits: It parses only the site's current markup with regexes, stores metadata and links only, does not regenerate SKILL.md, STYLE_INDEX.md or briefs (build.py does), and drops every non-PromptsMotion record that is missing from its hard-coded BASE list.
tools.evidence_note: No test file exercises it. Re-run here in a scratch copy (sync_catalog.py plus catalog/styles.json and categories.json): --help exit 0. --offline with no cache exit 2, after creating .cache/promptsmotion/pages/. --offline with a synthetic 55-card cached index exit 0: 343 records (55 new, 0 changed, 243 unlisted), and 'dua' was gone. '--limit 20 --workers 3 --offline' was accepted (exit 0). Online mode was not run (network).

tools.summary_en: Runs 14 integrity checks on the style atlas and prints a numbered PASS/WARN/FAIL report or JSON. It checks that catalog/styles.json parses with unique slug ids, that catalog/categories.json is a valid taxonomy, record fields, enums and https URLs, known categories, aspect_label against the pixel size, and that styles/<id>/SKILL.md exists and STYLE.json equals the record. It also checks for orphan folders, STYLE_INDEX.md coverage, prompts_motion and briefs consistency, playbook files, rehosted media under styles/ or catalog/, matching request-template placeholders and meta totals.
tools.summary_ar: يُجري 14 فحصًا لسلامة أطلس الأنماط، ويطبع تقريرًا مرقّمًا بحالات النجاح أو التحذير أو الفشل، أو تقريرًا بصيغة JSON. يتحقق من صلاحية catalog/styles.json وتفرّد معرّفاته وصيغتها، ومن صحة تصنيف catalog/categories.json، ومن حقول السجلات وقيمها المسموحة وروابط https، ومن أن الفئات معروفة وأن aspect_label يطابق الأبعاد، ومن وجود styles/<id>/SKILL.md وتطابق STYLE.json مع السجل. ويفحص كذلك المجلدات اليتيمة، وذكر كل معرّف في STYLE_INDEX.md، واتساق prompts_motion وbriefs، ووجود ملفات الأدلة، وخلو styles/ وcatalog/ من ملفات وسائط مُعاد استضافتها، وتطابق متغيرات قالبي الطلب، وإجماليات meta.

tools.inputs: A repository root (default: this checkout; --root DIR for another one) containing catalog/ (styles.json, categories.json, plus prompts_motion.json, briefs.json, playbooks.json and meta.json when present), styles/, STYLE_INDEX.md, playbooks/ and templates/.

tools.title_en: KOSIF Telegram Typography Atlas — private-safe font knowledge and idea search

tools.summary_en: Search a public metadata index of the 5,514 SHA-256-distinct fonts found in the user's own Telegram Desktop exports (4,634 with Arabic letters): one row per family with its styles, Arabic spelling-tolerant style words (كوفي، رقعة، ديواني، ثلث، نسخ), an open-license filter, and 16 original design directions. scan/enrich-zips rebuild the index on the user's machine (bounded, in-memory ZIP reads); refresh re-derives tags, name-based license flags, ideas and counts from the public index alone. Fonts, chats, images and local paths never leave the device.
tools.summary_ar: ابحث في فهرس بيانات 5,514 خطًا فريدًا من صادرات تيليجرام الخاصة بك (4,634 تدعم العربية): صف لكل عائلة بأوزانها، وكلمات الأنماط بالعربي (كوفي، رقعة، ديواني، ثلث، نسخ) مع تسامح الإملاء، وفلتر للرخص المفتوحة، و16 اتجاهًا تصميميًا أصليًا. الخطوط والرسائل والصور والمسارات تبقى على جهازك فقط.
use_when: Pick an Arabic or Latin font for a logo, poster, brand, reel or kinetic text from the fonts the user already collected
Find open-license (OFL) candidates in a style before designing, then measure them with font-fidelity-lab
اختار لي خط رقعة أو كوفي أو ديواني من مكتبة خطوطي لبوستر أو شعار مع حالة الرخصة

commands.name: find
commands.does: Read-only search of the public index: style tags and name words, one row per family (styles, file copies, license status), open-claimed licenses first on ties.

commands.name: find (open licenses only)
commands.does: Only fonts whose embedded name table claims OFL, Apache or public domain; --latin keeps fonts that also cover Latin (bilingual logos). Still unverified: confirm the license at the official source before use.

commands.name: doctor
commands.does: Says which commands this machine can run: find and refresh need nothing extra; scan needs beautifulsoup4, fonttools and Pillow; WOFF2 inside ZIPs needs brotli.

commands.name: refresh
commands.does: Re-derive whole-word tags, name-based license flags (trial/demo/personal use), design ideas, counts and limitations from the public index alone; never overwrites.

commands.name: scan
commands.does: On the user's machine: index loose TTF/OTF fonts, chat themes and image headers of ChatExport* folders into a public file and a separate private locator; refuses overwrites and outputs inside the exports. The private locator must be written outside any git checkout (on Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\KOSIF\typography-private); the command refuses otherwise.

commands.name: enrich-zips
commands.does: Add fonts found inside ZIP archives: decompression capped per member, traversal/absolute/encrypted members refused, nothing extracted; an already-enriched catalog is refused; ideas and counts rebuilt over all fonts.

tools.inputs: Authorized user-supplied local Telegram Desktop ChatExport folders and local ZIP font archives; no scripts or executables run.
tools.outputs: Public metadata index (no font bytes, chats, images, URLs or local paths) with 16 design directions, and a separate private local-only locator. redistribution_approved stays false for every font until a person checks the actual license.
tools.consent: Read only the user's authorized exported chat backups. Never upload raw messages, senders, URLs, font bytes, photo assets or private file locations to GitHub; use only actually licensed fonts for production.
tools.limits: Metadata and message keyword themes, not understanding of every photo (2,981 image headers read; 80 photos sampled once). 4 exports, 2,766 messages, 1,269 loose font files and 5,283 font members in 89 ZIPs gave 5,514 distinct font binaries (~2,412 family names). 1 ZIP unreadable and 36 ZIP fonts unparsed; EOT/.glyphs members, RAR, PDF and nested archives not indexed. Message-theme counts come from the original on-device tagger. License labels come from embedded names only and never grant permission (534 flagged restricted, 402 of them by trial/demo/personal-use/unlicensed names). find and refresh need only Python; scan needs fonttools, beautifulsoup4 and Pillow (optional list), WOFF2 in ZIPs needs brotli.
tools.evidence_note: 22 unit tests run in this checkout (synthetic fonts, collections and ZIPs: privacy of the public file, no file-name or link leaks, bounded ZIP reads, traversal refusal, private locator never inside a git checkout, whole-word Arabic-aware tags, exact-family ranking, family collapse, refresh determinism) plus a privacy check of the committed index. The index itself was produced on the user's authorized laptop on 2026-10-20 and refreshed here.

tools.summary_en: Before any substantial request: scans 100% of the catalog records with a SHA-256 coverage receipt that fails closed on unreadable or unclassified records, checks that every derived index is fresh, drafts a request analysis, ranks groups, fused superpowers, powers and runnable tools, scores candidates (fit 35, integration 20, feasibility 15, evidence 10, cost 10, creativity 10) and drafts plans A/B/C with a recommendation and the approval question.

tools.title_en: FusionForge v2 project-scoped composite workflow recipes
tools.title_ar: FusionForge v2 لوصفات الـWorkflow المركبة داخل المشروع
tools.summary_en: Turns the USIP brief (skill_intelligence is the single ranker) into a project-scoped candidate recipe: typed workflow nodes per stage holding catalog superpowers fingerprinted by their atom IDs, input/output artifact kinds, an executor reference and handoff edges, with plans A/B/C taken from the brief. It then records the approved plan, per-node traces with hashed evidence and every status change through an enforced state machine (candidate, planned, tested, then verified or failed) whose verified gate checks the records; validate runs checks V01-V12, and lessons, reuse and propose's recall rank the same project's earlier recipes. Cards and redacted bundles carry recipes to another session. Writes only under out/fusionforge/<project>/; it never executes a power, installs, publishes or edits the catalog.
tools.summary_ar: يحوّل تقرير USIP (والمرتِّب الوحيد هو skill_intelligence) إلى وصفة مرشحة داخل المشروع: عُقد Workflow لكل مرحلة تحمل قدرات الكتالوج ببصمة ذراتها، وأنواع المدخلات والمخرجات، ومرجع المنفّذ، وحواف التسليم، مع الخطط A وB وC من التقرير نفسه. ثم يسجّل الخطة المعتمدة، وسجل تنفيذ لكل عقدة ببصمات الأدلة، وكل تغيير حالة عبر آلة حالات مُلزمة (candidate ثم planned ثم tested ثم verified أو failed) لها بوابة تحقق تفحص السجلات؛ ويجري validate الفحوص V01–V12، وترتّب lessons وreuse واستدعاءُ propose وصفاتِ المشروع نفسه السابقة. والبطاقات والحزم المنقّحة تنقل الوصفات إلى جلسة أخرى. يكتب فقط في out/fusionforge/<project>/، ولا ينفّذ قدرة ولا يثبّت شيئًا ولا ينشر ولا يعدّل الكتالوج.
use_when: اعمل وصفة توليف مهارات للمهمة دي وسجّل خطوات التنفيذ
ابتكر workflow مركب من مهارات متعددة واحفظه للمشروع
رتّب وصفات المشروع السابقة لهدف جديد وقل لي أي تجربة فاشلة أتجنبها
Compose several superpowers into a reusable workflow recipe for this project
Record the evidence for each step of the composite workflow I just ran
Export this project's FusionForge recipes so the next cloud session can import them

commands.name: propose
commands.example: python3 scripts/fusionforge.py propose "مونتاج ريلز بترجمة عربية" --project demo_project --from-brief out/20261021-reel/brief.json
commands.does: Builds a candidate v2 recipe from the brief (without --from-brief it runs the brief in process; the brief is saved beside the recipe): typed nodes and edges for plans A/B/C, recall of this project's earlier recipes and similar-unverified links. Needs a complete coverage receipt; NO_MATCH exits 3 with a --terms hint. Also --terms, --max-capabilities 1-60 (default 24) and --id.

commands.name: reuse
commands.example: python3 scripts/fusionforge.py reuse "مونتاج ريلز بترجمة عربية" --project demo_project --from-brief out/20261021-reel/brief.json
commands.does: Read-only: ranks this project's earlier recipes by sim x strength x recency x freshness (sim_basis says goal text or goal + capabilities) and lists failed ones under avoid with their lessons. --top N, --no-brief, --terms.

commands.name: validate
commands.does: Read-only checks V01-V12: schema, status log, handoff kinds, a final verify, executors, evidence present and unchanged, secrets, self-evidence, verified without a run, catalog drift and unknown capabilities (the last two warnings). Exit 4 on any error.

commands.name: choose
commands.example: python3 scripts/fusionforge.py choose --project demo_project --id FUSE-20261021-0123456789 --plan B --why "balanced quality for a 30-second reel"
commands.does: Records the user's plan (A, B, C, or D with --nodes N01,N02) and moves candidate to planned; needs a clean validate and resets every node to pending. Node results count only after this.

commands.name: trace
commands.example: python3 scripts/fusionforge.py trace --project demo_project --id FUSE-20261021-0123456789 --stage verify --node N06 --action "Ran verify_video.py on the render" --result passed --tool tool:verify-video --observed "1080x1920, 30 fps, -14.1 LUFS" --evidence out/20261021-reel/qa.json
commands.does: Appends one executed step and updates the node's status (skipped needs --observed; failed can carry --error-class); records tool substitutions; refuses credentials, unknown capability IDs and final recipes. Also --input, --output, --capabilities.

commands.name: record
commands.example: python3 scripts/fusionforge.py record --project demo_project --id FUSE-20261021-0123456789 --status tested --evidence out/20261021-reel/qa.json
commands.does: Enforced transitions with a status log: tested needs evidence and at least one trace with a result; failed needs evidence and --note; planned is set only by choose (USE_CHOOSE).

commands.name: record --status verified
commands.example: python3 scripts/fusionforge.py record --project demo_project --id FUSE-20261021-0123456789 --status verified --evidence out/20261021-reel/final-qa.json --qa-pass
commands.does: The verified gate: tested state, --qa-pass, every node of the chosen plan passed or skipped, a verify node passed with local evidence, evidence unlike any failure evidence of the project and not already used to verify another recipe, and a clean validate. --baseline FILE keeps the comparison file (stored, not compared).

commands.name: lessons
commands.does: Rebuilds <project>/lessons.json from every recipe's traces: WORKED, FAILED, REPLACED, HANDOFF and RECIPE_FAILED, with per-executor counts (assumed executors counted apart).

commands.name: fork
commands.does: New candidate from any recipe (verified and failed are final) with statuses reset and forked_from kept; --new-id sets its ID.

commands.name: set-graph
commands.example: python3 scripts/fusionforge.py set-graph --project demo_project --id FUSE-20261021-0123456789 --file out/20261021-reel/graph.json
commands.does: Replaces a candidate's nodes, edges and plans after checking every field and handoff kind (GRAPH_INVALID otherwise).

commands.name: bind
commands.example: python3 scripts/fusionforge.py bind --project demo_project --id FUSE-20261021-0123456789 --node N03 --executor tool:montage-pro
commands.does: Sets a node's executor on a candidate or planned recipe: tool:<tools.json id>, bin:<name>, mcp:<server/tool>, method:<atom id> or human.

commands.name: card
commands.does: Writes <project>/cards/<id>.md (or --out FILE.md): a Markdown card with an embedded kosif.fusionforge.card.v2 JSON block, no absolute paths, evidence by sha256, for claude.ai without a shell.

commands.name: import-card
commands.does: New candidate from a card (status forced to candidate, provenance card); malformed cards stop with CARD_INVALID.

commands.name: export
commands.does: Writes a redacted kosif.fusionforge.bundle.v2 (recipes + lessons) to <project>/exports/<project>-<YYYYMMDD>.json (or --out FILE.json) for opt-in persistence; never committed. --include-candidates adds unfinished recipes.

commands.name: import
commands.does: Imports a bundle of the same project; statuses kept with imported: true; evidence not on this machine is a warning and weighs x0.8 in reuse; verified and promote need a new local verify run.

commands.name: migrate
commands.does: Converts v1 recipes to v2 with byte-identical backups under <project>/legacy/; a v1 verified recipe with no trace is flagged legacy_unproven (x0.3 in reuse, never promoted).

commands.name: promote
commands.does: Writes <project>/promotions/<id>.proposal.json in state pending_human for a verified recipe proved on this machine; never edits the catalog.

commands.name: show
commands.does: Read-only: one recipe (a malformed record gets a short summary instead of a crash).

commands.name: catalog
commands.does: Read-only listing of the project's recipes by status; invalid files are listed, never fatal; creates no folders.

tools.inputs: A goal in the user's words, a project slug ([A-Za-z0-9_-]) and, preferably, the brief.json from skill_intelligence.py brief --out; later a recipe ID, a plan letter, a stage, node, executor reference or status, and local evidence files (regular, non-empty files inside the working directory, its git checkout, the FusionForge root or the skill's checkout). Global options: --root, --catalog-file, --tools-file, --now; every command takes --json.
tools.outputs: Under <root>/<project>/ (root: --root, else $KOSIF_FUSIONFORGE_ROOT, else <git top>/out/fusionforge, git-ignored): recipes (kosif.fusionforge.recipe.v2) with their saved brief, index.json, lessons.json, content-addressed evidence copies up to 5 MB, cards, export bundles, legacy backups and promotion proposals. stdout: a short summary, or full JSON with --json (always with "root"). Errors are one line 'fusionforge: error: CODE: message'; exit 2 usage/validation/state, 3 NO_MATCH, 4 validate errors.
tools.consent: Writes only under the FusionForge root (out/fusionforge/<project>/, or --root / $KOSIF_FUSIONFORGE_ROOT); evidence files are read, hashed and copied there, never uploaded; nothing is committed, published or sent.
tools.limits: It never executes a power or tool: 'verified' means the caller's own QA passed this engine's gate on the records (states, traces, evidence hashes), not that the engine judged the work, and --baseline is stored but not compared. 'Learning' is lessons and rankings computed from the same project's recorded traces: nothing is learned across projects, no model is trained and nothing is swapped automatically. Records are local files under out/fusionforge/ (git-ignored): a new machine or a new cloud container starts empty unless the user exports a bundle or card and imports it there. Node I/O contracts are drafts (default_unconfirmed) until set-graph replaces them, the picks are only as good as the brief, and project isolation is the project folder name.
tools.evidence_note: 2026-10-21 on this checkout: evals/test_fusionforge.py 48/48 passed (python3 -m unittest; fixture catalog plus real-catalog smoke and determinism runs), and evals/test_usip_shadow.py ran the FusionForge shadow rows (-1.38#1-#10, -1.32#05, -1.32#22, R24) against the real catalog in a temporary root. An end-to-end run (propose, validate, choose, trace, record tested and verified, lessons, reuse, card, export, import, fork, promote, migrate) exited 0 at every step.

tools.summary_en: A 13-role team over an uploaded audio or video: measures it (ffprobe, loudness, energy cues, cuts, contact sheet), offers an option menu with a stage plan, acquires licensed footage IDM-style (segmented resumable download, DASH/HLS grab, rights.json), conforms to an edit mezzanine with proxies, and builds a kinetic film, visualizer, reframe, highlight reel, look or a reference-remix Remotion project, each verified with verify_video.py; the master audio is never modified; its transcribe command writes word timings (kosif-words/1 words.json) locally with faster-whisper, skipping silence and refusing to write into jobs/ or tracked paths.
tools.summary_ar: فريق من 13 دورًا لملف صوت أو فيديو مرفوع: يقيس المادة، ويعرض قائمة خيارات وخطة مراحل، ويجلب لقطات مرخصة بأسلوب IDM مع سجل حقوق، ويوحد الصيغ، وينتج فيلم موشن أو مصوّرًا صوتيًا أو إعادة تأطير أو ريلًا مختصرًا أو لوكًا سينمائيًا أو مشروع Remotion، مع فحص كل ناتج والحفاظ على الصوت الأصلي، وأمر transcribe يكتب توقيت الكلمات (words.json بصيغة kosif-words/1) محليًا بـ faster-whisper مع تخطي الصمت ورفض الكتابة داخل jobs/ أو الملفات المتتبعة.

tools.title_en: Reel factory: voice + word timings + licensed shots → verified 9:16 reel
tools.title_ar: مصنع الريلز: صوت وتوقيت كلمات ولقطات مرخصة ← ريلز 9:16 مفحوص
tools.summary_en: A thin wrapper over existing tools: records the audio's declared rights and every shot's licence in rights.json (advisory, never blocking — gaps are listed and said once), takes words.json or runs montage_pro transcribe, plans one shot per phrase with xfades centred on the cuts (duration = audio + 1 s), builds a 4:5 footage plate with ffmpeg, renders a word-by-word Arabic scene (Aref Ruqaa / Reem Kufi, gold frame draw-on, handle and credit inside the safe zone, parametric styles) through tools/render_html.cjs, muxes the original audio with -c copy and gates the result with verify_video.py --source-audio. Outputs go to the git-ignored out/reels/<slug>.
tools.summary_ar: غلاف رفيع فوق الأدوات الموجودة: يسجّل حقوق الصوت المعلنة ورخصة كل لقطة في rights.json (إرشادي لا يمنع — الفجوات تُسجَّل وتُذكر مرة)، ويأخذ words.json أو يشغّل transcribe، ويخطط لقطة لكل جملة مع انتقالات متمركزة على القطع (المدة = الصوت + ثانية)، ويبني لوحة لقطات 4:5 بـ ffmpeg، ويرسم مشهدًا عربيًا كلمة بكلمة (رقعة وكوفي، إطار ذهبي يُرسم، التوقيع والإشادة داخل المنطقة الآمنة، أنماط متغيرة) عبر render_html.cjs، ثم يدمج الصوت الأصلي بلا إعادة ترميز ويفحص الناتج بـ verify_video.py --source-audio. المخرجات في out/reels/<slug> المتجاهَل من git.

commands.does: Plan, plate, scene, render, -c copy mux and verify_video --source-audio; writes OUT/reel.mp4, TEST_REPORT.md and build.json (inputs sha256, commands, results). Exit 4 when the build or the verification fails.

tools.inputs: An AAC or MP3 voice (never re-encoded); optional --audio-rights (and evidence) recorded in rights.json; --words words.json or --transcribe; --shots shots.json or a stock_fetch manifest with --shot-ids; optional --title, --handle, --credit, --phrases (text overrides), --style (preset or seed), --min-shot, --out, --allow-tracked, --draft.
tools.outputs: OUT/rights.json, plan.json, words.json (with --transcribe), build/ (plate JPGs, scene.html, fonts with OFL texts), reel.mp4, TEST_REPORT.md and build.json. Exit 0 ok, 2 usage/input error or missing tool, 4 BUILD_FAILED/VERIFY_FAILED; rights gaps never change the exit code.
tools.consent: It never fetches or publishes anything; the rights you declare for the audio and the shots are recorded in rights.json with any gaps (by the owner's decision this is advisory and never stops a build), it writes only under the chosen out folder (never jobs/, tracked paths or the skill folder unless --allow-tracked), and it never re-encodes the user's audio.
tools.limits: The rights record only checks that declarations and evidence were supplied in the right shape; it does not verify a permission or licence and does not stop a build that lacks them. Word-timing accuracy is not measured against a reference. One template family (four palettes, three transition sets, three frames; a numeric seed never repeats a preset exactly); about 0.26 s per 1080x1920 frame here, so about 2 min for a 15 s reel.
tools.evidence_note: evals/test_reel_factory.py 34/34 OK here (the build smoke test renders a tiny draft reel; it skips without ffmpeg, node or Chromium). On 22-10 the real dua audio declared as direct-permission without evidence planned with rights.json status incomplete and one RIGHTS_NOTE; an owned 6 s voice with three Pexels shots built a 1080x1920 reel that verify_video --source-audio passed 12/12 (packet MD5 equal to the source).

commands.does: Calls the existing REA static inspection planner on the supplied path; no target execution.

tools.inputs: Subcommand doctor|catalog|inspect PATH|plan GOAL --domain auto|image|motion|investigation|rea-plan KIND PATH; optional --out JSON in existing directory. inspect supports bounded regular files up to 512MiB. Does not decode images, or inspect PSD layers.
tools.outputs: JSON method registry, read-only image header report with SHA-256, or a no-execution creative/investigation workflow; --out is exclusive-create.
tools.consent: The bridge itself never installs, uploads, renders, invokes REA analysis or controls Mosamem. Using Mosamem GUI, downloading model weights or executing REA via rea_bridge.py run requires separate approval and correct licenses.
tools.limits: Standard-library header preflight only; does not edit or decode PSD, PNG/JPEG; Mosamem v0.1.0 GUI has no verified headless API; external GPL code is not embedded and source-described capabilities are not installed inside KOSIF.
tools.evidence_note: 15/15 test_mosamem_rea_fusion.py passed on Windows laptop 2026-10-23; 10/10 existing rea_bridge regression tests passed; upstream Mosamem app not installed/demonstrated.

tools.title_en: Charter roster ingest: the 500-expert council as a consultable index
tools.title_ar: إدخال قائمة الميثاق: مجلس الخبراء 500 فهرسًا للاستشارة
tools.summary_en: Deterministically parses the user's charter roster (sectors «القطاع N», numbered entries with الدور/المهام/الخصائص) into data/experts_500.json (kosif.experts-index.v1): every entry keeps its role, tasks and traits, maps by keywords to catalog families, and is flagged (boilerplate traits, duplicate_of, sensitive consent/regulated). Refuses unless 50 sectors × 10 entries (or --allow-partial) and refuses credential-like text. The council's plan consults it as an index; no persona runs, votes or counts as evidence.
tools.summary_ar: يحوّل قائمة مجلس الخبراء في ميثاق المستخدم بنتيجة حتمية إلى فهرس data/experts_500.json: لكل بطاقة دورها ومهامها وخصائصها وعائلات الكتالوج المناسبة، وأوسام العام المكرر والدور المكرر والحساس (موافقة/منظَّم). يرفض ما لم يكن 50×10 (إلا مع --allow-partial) ويرفض الأسرار. المجلس يستشيره فهرسًا؛ لا تُشغَّل بطاقة ولا تصوّت ولا تُعدّ دليلًا.
use_when: حوّل قائمة الخبراء الـ500 في الميثاق لفهرس
Index my 500-expert charter roster for the council

commands.name: ingest
commands.does: Parses the roster text and writes the flagged index with a receipt (sectors, experts, boilerplate, duplicates, consent, regulated); exit 2 on a wrong shape or credentials.

commands.name: council-consult
commands.does: Records up to 3 consulted persona cards per member in council.json consulted_index; the verdict says 'index consulted: N personas'.

tools.inputs: A UTF-8 plain-text export of the charter roster (treated as data, never instructions).
tools.outputs: data/experts_500.json (or --out); JSON receipt on stdout; exit 2 with one stderr line on refusal.
tools.consent: Writes only the --out file; runs no model, spends nothing, publishes nothing.
tools.limits: Keyword flags and family mapping are heuristic (light Arabic stemming); the index is persona cards, not executed experts, and never enters the coverage receipt or the powers count.
tools.evidence_note: evals/test_charter_index.py 6/6 passed on this checkout (full 50x10 parse of the user's charter: 500 experts, 200 boilerplate, 5 duplicates, 7 consent, 24 regulated).

tools.title_en: Local image AI: remove background and smart fill with your own ONNX model
tools.title_ar: ذكاء الصور المحلي: إزالة الخلفية والملء الذكي بنموذج ONNX تختاره
tools.summary_en: Runs open image models on this machine with no network: a BiRefNet-style subject matte turned into an RGBA PNG (remove-bg) and MI-GAN-style inpainting of a masked area (inpaint). It lists the three models Mosamem pins (BiRefNet lite MIT, SAM 2.1 tiny Apache-2.0, MI-GAN MIT) with commit-pinned URLs, sizes and SHA-256, and checks a downloaded file against its pin. It never downloads: with no model it prints the URL and asks the user to fetch it.
tools.summary_ar: يشغّل نماذج صور مفتوحة على الجهاز بلا شبكة: قناع موضوع بأسلوب BiRefNet يتحول إلى PNG شفاف (remove-bg) وملء ذكي بأسلوب MI-GAN لمنطقة محددة بقناع (inpaint). يعرض النماذج الثلاثة التي يثبتها مصمم (BiRefNet lite وSAM 2.1 tiny وMI-GAN) بروابط مثبتة وأحجام وبصمات SHA-256، ويتحقق من الملف المنزّل. لا ينزّل شيئًا أبدًا: إن غاب النموذج يطبع الرابط ويطلب من المستخدم تنزيله.
use_when: شيل الخلفية من الصورة على جهازي من غير نت
امسح الشخص ده من الصورة واملأ مكانه
Remove the background offline with a local model
Inpaint the masked area of this photo without uploading it

commands.name: models
commands.does: Lists the three pinned open models with licence, source, size, URL and SHA-256 (facts from Mosamem's models.rs); downloads nothing.

commands.name: verify-model
commands.does: SHA-256 of a local file against --sha256 or the known pin for its file name; exit 1 on mismatch, 2 if missing.

commands.name: remove-bg
commands.example: python3 scripts/image_local_ai.py remove-bg --model birefnet_lite_fp16.onnx in.png out.png --mask-out matte.png
commands.does: ImageNet-normalised input at the model's side, sigmoid matte, soft alpha; writes an RGBA PNG and prints JSON with coverage.

commands.name: inpaint
commands.example: python3 scripts/image_local_ai.py inpaint --model migan_pipeline_v2.onnx --mask hole.png in.png out.png
commands.does: Grows the white mask area ~2 model px, runs an image/mask uint8 model, pastes back only the user's hole; prints JSON.

tools.inputs: A PNG/JPEG image, a mask PNG (white = fill) for inpaint, and a local ONNX model file the user downloaded themselves.
tools.outputs: out.png (RGBA for remove-bg, RGB for inpaint), optional matte PNG, one JSON summary on stdout; exit 2 with one line on stderr when a dependency or the model is missing.
tools.consent: Writes only the named output files. It never downloads; fetching a model (28–115 MB) from the printed URL is the user's own decision.
tools.limits: Tested here only with synthetic ONNX graphs, so it checks I/O and behaviour, not BiRefNet or MI-GAN quality; SAM 2.1 is listed but not wrapped; CPU only.
tools.evidence_note: evals/test_image_local_ai.py 8 passed, 1 skipped (onnx.checker; onnx not installed) on this checkout, 2026-10-22; remove-bg and inpaint ran end to end on hand-encoded synthetic ONNX graphs with onnxruntime 1.29. No real model was downloaded.

tools.title_en: Prompt pack: copyable prompts, one code block each, with a warn-only lint
tools.title_ar: حزمة المطالبات: كل مطالبة في كتلة كود قابلة للنسخ مع فحص يحذّر فقط
tools.summary_en: Turns a list of prompts or a scene/story spec into PACK.md and pack.json: every English prompt in ONE fenced block (wrapped in dir="ltr" for RTL pages), the Arabic explanation outside it, and a per-engine suffix from data/prompt_engines.json (Midjourney V7 flags marked version-sensitive, generic image negative line, generic video 'No subtitles or on-screen text.'). The lint only warns (contradictions, unseparated subjects, studio/artist/brand names, quality hype, text-in-image, missing negative baseline) and never rewrites a word; credential-like values are refused. It calls no engine.
tools.summary_ar: يحوّل قائمة مطالبات أو مواصفة مشاهد/قصة إلى PACK.md وpack.json: كل مطالبة إنجليزية في كتلة كود واحدة (داخل dir="ltr" للصفحات العربية) والشرح العربي خارجها، مع لاحقة لكل محرك من data/prompt_engines.json. الفحص يحذّر فقط (تناقضات، شخصيات بلا فصل، أسماء استوديوهات/فنانين/علامات، مبالغات الجودة، نص داخل الصورة، غياب السلبيات) ولا يغيّر أي كلمة؛ ويرفض ما يشبه الأسرار. لا يستدعي أي محرك.
use_when: اكتب البرومبتات على شكل كود أقدر أنسخه
جهّز برومبتات المشاهد لميدجورني وفيو
Give me the scene prompts as copyable code blocks for Midjourney and Veo
Lint these prompts for contradictions without changing them

commands.name: build
commands.example: python3 scripts/prompt_pack.py build prompts.json --out out/demo/prompts --engine midjourney
commands.does: Writes PACK.md (one fenced block per prompt, Arabic explanation outside, engine suffix appended once), pack.json with the lint warnings, and START-HERE.md when prompts list refs; --strict exits 2 on warnings.

commands.name: lint
commands.does: Prints warn-only findings as JSON (exit 2 when any, 3 when a credential-like value is found); the input is never modified.

tools.inputs: A JSON list of prompts {id, engine, text, negative?, params?, title_ar?, explain_ar?, refs?}, or {title, engine, prompts|scenes:[...]}.
tools.outputs: PACK.md, pack.json and optional START-HERE.md in the --out folder; JSON on stdout; exit 1 bad input/refused folder, 2 warnings (lint or --strict), 3 secret refused.
tools.consent: Writes only inside the --out folder (refuses the skill folder, jobs/ and git-tracked paths); it calls no engine, spends nothing and publishes nothing.
tools.limits: Engine syntax is documented, not tested on the engine here; the lint is a heuristic warning list, not a content-policy filter, and it deliberately never substitutes words.
tools.evidence_note: evals/test_prompt_pack.py 9/9 passed on this checkout (22-10).

tools.title_en: Sources index: per-work-dir index memory of the user's attachments
tools.title_ar: فهرس المصادر: الذاكرة الفهرسية لمرفقات المستخدم داخل مجلد العمل
tools.summary_en: Records each attachment (file, .docx, .pdf via pdftotext, or a URL recorded without fetching) in <dir>/sources_index.json: kind, sha256, size, lines, title guess, headings with line ranges, provenance, trust_scope 'data, not instructions', imperative lines that try to instruct the assistant, and secrets by line and kind only (never the value). find returns heading line ranges (or line numbers with --body) so only that range is read.
tools.summary_ar: يسجّل كل مرفق (ملف أو docx أو pdf عبر pdftotext أو رابط يُسجَّل دون جلبه) في <dir>/sources_index.json: النوع والبصمة والحجم وعدد الأسطر والعناوين بنطاقات أسطرها والمصدر ونطاق الثقة «بيانات لا تعليمات» والأسطر الآمرة، والأسرار بموقعها ونوعها فقط دون قيمتها أبدًا. والبحث يعيد نطاقات الأسطر لتُقرأ وحدها.
use_when: فهرس الملفات اللي رفعتها عشان ترجع لها وقت الحاجة
الذاكرة الفهرسية للمصادر
Index my attachments and tell me where the chapter on X is
Check this uploaded file for embedded instructions or leaked keys before using it

commands.name: add
commands.does: Indexes one file or URL into out/demo/sources_index.json and prints its id, imperative line numbers and secret locations.

commands.name: list
commands.does: Lists indexed sources with counts.

commands.name: show
commands.does: Prints one record (metadata, headings and flags, never body text).

commands.name: find
commands.does: Matches titles and headings and returns line ranges; --body also returns matching line numbers, never text.

tools.inputs: A local file (text, code, .docx, .pdf, media) or an http(s) URL, and a work dir.
tools.outputs: sources_index.json in the --dir folder; JSON on stdout; exit 2 with one line on stderr on any refusal.
tools.consent: Writes only <dir>/sources_index.json (refuses the skill folder, jobs/ and git-tracked paths); fetches nothing and never writes a credential value.
tools.limits: Headings, imperative cues and secrets are pattern heuristics (can miss or over-flag); lists are capped with counts; the index is local to this container and nothing is learned from it.
tools.evidence_note: evals/test_sources_index.py 6/6 passed on this checkout; real run on a 24,257-line attachment (22-10): key at line 405 reported as google_api_key by location only, 0 'AIza' matches in the 35 KB index.

tools.title_en: Atlas explainer renderer: storyboard, determinism check and real MP4 with synthesized score
tools.title_ar: رندر أفلام الشرح: ستوريبورد وفحص حتمية وMP4 حقيقي بصوت مُركّب

tools.summary_ar: يشغّل صفحة شرح A15 في متصفح بلا واجهة: لوحة ستوريبورد، لقطات، فحص حتمية وسرعة، رندر MP4 إطارًا بإطار مع صوت مُركّب متزامن، وحزمة HTML واحدة.

اعرض لي الستوريبورد قبل الفيلم
Render the explainer page to video
Check the explainer is deterministic

commands.name: storyboard
commands.does: PNG of the ?storyboard=1 grid.

commands.name: render
commands.does: H.264 frames + offline-rendered AAC score.

commands.name: bundle
commands.does: Inlines scripts and the font into one HTML file.

tools.outputs: PNG storyboard/stills, MP4 (h264+aac), single-file HTML, JSON reports
tools.consent: Writes only the --out path; refuses to overwrite without --force; no network.

Turn a podcast into a content plan with AI
Plan an AI workflow for my sales team

commands.name: coverage
commands.does: Native vs connector/approval steps per workflow.

tools.inputs: data/futurepedia_business_workflows.json and the user's situation
tools.outputs: JSON listings and a Markdown runbook
tools.consent: Writes only the new --out file; never sends, posts, spends or records; plans mark every such step as needing explicit approval.
